title: Modern Oasis Scottsdale:Two En-Suites & HeatedPool
description:
A Beautiful, Modern Home in the heart of Old Town. Sleeps Family of 12 in Comfort! Five Bedrooms and Three Bathrooms

✴HIGHLIGHTS ✴ 
5 Bedrooms and 3 BATHROOMS! Large Yard, Modern Lux Furnishings, TWO En-Suites.

✴PRIME LOCATION✴ 
-1 block takes you on the Greenbelt for walking, running, & biking 
-1.5 miles to all the excitement of the Old Town Entertainment District 
-Walking distance to SF Giants Spring Training 
-Quick jaunt to Waste Mgmt. Phoenix Open 
-Great shopping nearby

 The space 
Pool Heat Fee: $75/night from October-April, $25/night for the rest of the year (often not needed). A 2-night minimum is generally required, with discounts available for heating requests of 4 nights or more.

Early Check-In and Early Check-Out:
Subject to availability, early check-in and early check-out are each available for an additional fee of $100.

Note: There is no parking garage.

✴ There is plenty to do while practicing social distancing. Within 1 block, we have the Scottsdale Greenbelt for running, walking, and biking!

✴ THREE BATHROOMS, TWO EN SUITES

The house offers two master suites, including a luxurious Primary Bedroom + En Suite with huge walk-in closet, dual shower-head shower, spa-like bathtub, double vanities and 2 additional bathrooms for getting ready for a night on the town! 

✴DESTINATION: SCOTTSDALE! 

This is your ideal haven for Family Reunions, Bachelor/Bachelorette Gatherings (no parties- just your group please!), Golf Trips, Spring Training, Couples’ Getaways, and anyone wanting to spend some time in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale and experience all that this amazing city offers. 

✴LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION! 

Convenient access to the 101 freeway, which will take you anywhere you need to go! UBER or Lyft are readily available, as are golf carts and electric scooters. 

Walk a few blocks to grab your morning coffee at the nearby Starbucks. Or if you have a donut fix, the Local Donut Shop is less than a half-mile away! 

✴A BREATH OF FRESH AIR 

This is a SMOKE-FREE & PET-FREE home. In the event that you will be traveling with a service animal, please ask the host to send over the Courteous Conduct and Cleanliness Agreement for your review and agreement prior to your stay. 

✴WHAT MAKES US SPECIAL 

The home was professionally designed with high-end furnishings and 5-star hotel quality amenities to pamper you in luxury. With a great deal of love and TLC, we carefully selected our favorite deluxe bath products, specialty coffee, fluffy spa-like towels, linens, etc. that are typically found in your favorite hotels. Enjoy the comforts of being in a luxury home with the perks of a fancy hotel! 

As your hosts, our aim is to give you the wonderful service you seek when on vacation. You will love our house book with TONS of suggestions on: dining, golf, restaurants, nightlife, family fun, etc. We love sharing our love of Scottsdale with our guests! 

Scottsdale City's family size is defined as 6 adults and their related dependent children.
Scottsdale license number: 2023755
Arizona TPT license number: 21342070

 Guest access 
You'll have access to the entire house and the back yard, with the exception of locked cabinets where owner's supplies are stored.

 Other things to note 
There is a Ring Video device on the exterior of the front door, and one above the garage, which record 30 seconds of video facing the front yard and street, upon detection of motion. The camera is not constantly recording. There is also a Minut Point noise decibel monitor in the back patio, which does not record sound/audio, but tracks how loud the general environment is.

To help us ensure a smooth and safe experience for everyone, we kindly ask that all guests provide a secondary contact number after booking. This can be your own number or someone else’s who will be staying at the property, just in case we need to reach you quickly in an emergency.

If you're booking on behalf of someone else and won’t be present during the stay, we simply ask for a contact number for the guest who will be staying.

We’ll always respect your privacy and only use this information if absolutely necessary. Thanks so much for your understanding.
